apple_dial_already_streaming_here: A second connect to a host this Mac already streams. host: its name.
apple_dial_failed_title: Title of the alert that shows why a connect failed.
apple_dial_unreachable_pinned: A paired host didn't answer. host: its name.
apple_dial_unreachable_unpaired: An unpaired host didn't answer. host: its name.
apple_hosts_field_mac_entry: Title of the TV text entry for the MAC field.
apple_link_open_library: Answer to a link that opens a host's library.
apple_link_unsaved_browse: A link opened the library of a host this device doesn't know. host: the name or address from the link.
apple_link_unsaved_connect: host: the name or address from the link; address: host:port it points at.
apple_link_unsaved_connect_fp: As link_unsaved_connect, for a link that also carries the host's fingerprint.
apple_unlock_biometry_reason: The reason the system's Face ID / Touch ID sheet shows after the app's name, so it starts lowercase. name: the profile; host: the host's name.
apple_unlock_password_for: Title of the TV text entry for the password. name: the profile's name.
apple_menu_hosts: Mac View menu item (title case) that shows the host list.
apple_menu_library: Mac View menu item (title case) that shows the library.
apple_hostcard_preset_a11y: VoiceOver label of a host card's preset chip. {preset} is the preset's name.
apple_hostcard_action_done_title: Alert title after a host accepted a power action.
apple_hostcard_resume_game: Button on a host's page while a game runs. {game} is its title.
apple_hostcard_speed_test_pair_first_bod: Shown instead of the speed test for an unpaired host. {host} is its name.
apple_hostcard_pair_status: Row label in a host's Pairing section; its value is Paired or Not paired.
apple_speedtest_about_body: Footnote on the speed test page. {host} is the host's name.
apple_speedtest_ready_body: Speed test caption before it starts. {host} is the host's name.
apple_speedtest_connecting_host: Speed test caption while connecting. {host} is the host's name.
apple_speedtest_measured_from_body: Speed test caption when only the throughput is known. {host} is the host's name.
apple_speedtest_measured_at_body: Second sentence of the result caption. {rate} is a figure with its unit.
apple_speedtest_chart_time_a11y: VoiceOver name of the chart's time axis.
apple_speedtest_chart_goodput_a11y: VoiceOver name of the chart's throughput values.
apple_speedtest_chart_average: Label on the chart's average line. {rate} is a figure with its unit.
apple_speedtest_chart_now: Label on the chart's line for the bitrate this host streams at now. {rate} is a figure with its unit.
apple_speedtest_average_a11y: VoiceOver name of the chart's average line.
apple_speedtest_now_a11y: VoiceOver name of the chart's line for the bitrate this host streams at now.
apple_speedtest_unreachable_body: Speed test failure. {address} is the host's address.
apple_lib_bad_art: Cause phrase after a frame's dash. Lowercase, no period.
apple_lib_last_played: Part of a title's play line. {when}: a relative time the system formats, e.g. '2 hr. ago'.
apple_lib_play_time_total: Part of a title's play line. {duration}: a duration the system formats, e.g. '14 hr'.
apple_lib_sections_note: Note in the section editor on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Vision Pro.
apple_lib_sections_note_tv: Note in the section editor on Apple TV.
apple_lib_sections_drag: Mac tooltip on a section's drag handle.
apple_ended_by_host: Why a stream ended. {host}: the host's name.
apple_ended_host_error: Why a stream ended. {host}: the host's name.
apple_ended_lost: Why a stream ended. {host}: the host's name.
apple_ended_unknown: Why a stream ended, when no reason came with the close. {host}: the host's name.
apple_menu_stream: Mac menu bar menu title. Title case.
apple_menu_cycle_statistics: Mac menu item: step the statistics overlay. Title case in English.
apple_menu_release_mouse: Mac menu item. Title case in English.
apple_menu_mute_microphone: Mac menu item. Title case in English.
apple_menu_unmute_microphone: Mac menu item. Title case in English.
apple_menu_share_clipboard: Mac menu item. Title case in English.
apple_menu_stop_sharing_clipboard: Mac menu item. Title case in English.
apple_menu_quick_actions: Mac menu item: open the quick actions ring. Title case in English.
apple_menu_toggle_fullscreen: Mac menu item. Title case in English.
apple_menu_disconnect: Mac menu item: end the stream. Title case in English.
apple_ring_editor_hint_click: Under the ring editor on a Mac.
apple_ring_no_touch_tv: Why touch actions are dimmed on Apple TV.
apple_ring_no_touch_mac: Why touch actions are dimmed on a Mac.
apple_ring_keyboard_mac: Why the on-screen keyboard action is dimmed on a Mac: its own keyboard already reaches the host.
apple_ring_stream_mute_unavailable: Why Mute this stream is dimmed on Apple devices.
apple_ring_note_no_touch_mac: Note under a touch action in the action picker on a Mac.
apple_ring_note_keyboard_mac: Note under Keyboard in the action picker on a Mac.
apple_ring_note_no_touch_tv: Note under a touch action in the action picker on Apple TV.
apple_ring_note_keyboard_tv: Note under Keyboard in the action picker on Apple TV.
apple_ring_note_mic_tv: Note under Microphone in the action picker on Apple TV.
apple_tv_ring_footer: Under the ring editor on Apple TV. {remote} is the Siri Remote's button name, {pad} a controller chord; both untranslated.
apple_tv_ring_move: Context menu item on a ring slot: pick it up to move it.
apple_tv_ring_clear: Context menu item on a ring slot: empty it.
apple_tv_ring_moving_hint: Beside the ring editor while a slot is being moved. {back} is the Siri Remote's Back button name, untranslated.
apple_tv_ring_pick_hint: Beside the ring editor on Apple TV, nothing focused.
apple_tv_ring_slot_hint: Beside the ring editor on Apple TV, a slot focused.
apple_pad_layout_control_a11y_hint: Screen reader hint on a control in the layout editor.
apple_controls_gesture_side_edge: A touch gesture on the stream controls page.
apple_controls_open_dial_passthrough: What the side-edge gesture does. Touch passthrough is a touch mode's name.
apple_controls_touch_surface: The Siri Remote's touch surface, on the stream controls page.
apple_controls_press: Pressing the Siri Remote's touch surface, on the stream controls page.
apple_controls_move_pointer: What the Siri Remote's touch surface does in a stream.
apple_controls_click: What pressing the Siri Remote's touch surface does: a mouse click on the host.
apple_controls_right_click: What the Siri Remote's Play/Pause does: a right click on the host.
apple_fullscreen_on_stream_always_hint: Mac, while editing a preset. Fullscreen and Always are the device setting and its option.
apple_match_window: Mac, iPhone, iPad switch above the resolution: the stream follows the window's size.
apple_resolution_this_device_size: Resolution entry: this device's own screen mode. {width}, {height}: pixels.
apple_resolution_this_device_safe_area_s: iPhone resolution entry: the screen minus the camera housing. {width}, {height}: pixels.
apple_resolution_this_display_size: Mac resolution entry: this display's panel. {width}, {height}: pixels.
apple_resolution_this_display_over_notch: Mac resolution entry: the whole panel, under the camera notch too. {width}, {height}: pixels.
apple_resolution_this_display_below_notc: Mac resolution entry: the panel below the camera notch. {width}, {height}: pixels.
apple_resolution_notch_hint: Mac, when the picked size covers the camera notch.
apple_use_display_mode: Button (or menu on a notched Mac): copy this display's size and rate into the fields.
apple_stream_mode: Apple TV row label: size and refresh rate together.
apple_stream_mode_native: Option of Stream mode: this TV's own mode.
apple_stream_mode_custom: Apple TV: a stored mode no list holds. {width}, {height}: pixels; {hz}: whole hertz.
apple_stream_mode_custom_native_size: Apple TV: a stored mode with the native size and a set rate. {hz}: whole hertz.
apple_stream_mode_custom_native_rate: Apple TV: a stored mode with a set size and the native rate. {width}, {height}: pixels.
apple_custom_size_placeholder: Apple TV row placeholder; selecting the row opens the system keyboard.
apple_custom_size_entry: Title of the Apple TV keyboard screen for a typed size.
apple_custom_scale_placeholder: Apple TV row placeholder; selecting the row opens the system keyboard.
apple_custom_bitrate_placeholder: Apple TV row placeholder; selecting the row opens the system keyboard.
apple_bitrate_kbps_gigabit_warning: Warning under the bitrate slider above 1 Gbit/s.
apple_present_priority_latency_default: Option of Prioritize, marked as the default.
apple_render_scale_host_size: Second sentence under Render scale. {width}, {height}: the pixels the host will render.
apple_preset_menu_name_color: Apple TV: opens the sheet that edits the preset's name and color.
apple_preset_menu_duplicate: Apple TV: opens the sheet that names a copy of the preset.
apple_preset_menu_duplicate_named: Preset chooser menu item. name is the preset's name.
apple_preset_menu_delete_named: Preset chooser menu item. name is the preset's name.
apple_preset_usage_hosts: Apple TV preset list, beside a preset: how many hosts use it as their default. Joined with apple_preset_usage_cards by a middle dot.
apple_preset_usage_cards: Apple TV preset list, beside a preset: how many host cards it is pinned to.
apple_preset_usage_none: Apple TV preset list: no host uses this preset.
apple_prefs_scope_defaults_hint: Caption under the Editing chooser while Default settings is selected.
apple_preset_duplicate_title: Title of the sheet that names a copy.
apple_preset_preview_name: Placeholder text on the preset chip preview while the name is empty.
apple_preset_edit_hint: Under the name field while editing a preset.
apple_about_community: About page link to the community chat.
apple_about_version_build: About page. version is the marketing version, build the build number.
apple_player_pointer_capture: iPad only: lock a hardware mouse.
apple_player_overlay_actions_opener_mac: Mac, first line of the Quick actions explainer. keys is the keyboard chord (⌃⌥⇧O), pad_keys the controller chord (Select + A). Stream is the menu bar menu's name.
apple_player_overlay_actions_opener: iPhone and iPad, first line of the Quick actions explainer. keys is the keyboard chord, pad_keys the controller chord.
apple_player_inhibit_shortcuts_release_h: Mac, second line of the Capture system shortcuts explainer. keys is the release chord, ⌘⎋.
apple_player_modifier_layout: Mac and iPad: how ⌥ and ⌘ map to the host's Alt and Super keys.
apple_player_modifier_layout_mac: Option of Modifier keys. Key symbols and names stay as written.
apple_player_modifier_layout_mac_hint: Caption while Modifier keys is Mac.
apple_player_modifier_layout_windows_hin: Caption while Modifier keys is Windows.
apple_audio_device_unavailable: Mac Speaker or Microphone option for a saved device that is gone.
apple_player_mic_channel_hint: Auto is the first option of this row.
apple_player_mic_channel_n: Option of Microphone channel. n is the interface's channel number.
apple_player_audio_format_opus_hint: Caption while Audio quality is Standard.
apple_player_audio_format_lossless_hint: Caption while Audio quality is a lossless rate. rate is the stereo cost in Mbit/s, a number formatted for the reader's language (2.3, 4.6).
apple_player_audio_format_surround_limit: Follows the lossless caption under 5.1 or 7.1 above 48 kHz.
apple_player_echo_cancel_mac_hint: Mac, second line of the Echo cancellation explainer.
apple_pad_home_button_hint: Home Button Overrides is the system setting's name: keep the system's own wording for it.
apple_pad_home_button_settings: Opens the system's controller Home button settings.
apple_player_sc2_capture_mac_hint: Mac. Input Monitoring is the macOS privacy setting's name.
apple_prefs_overridden_tv: Apple TV caption band over an overridden row: holding the remote's select opens the reset.
apple_overlay_access_full: Apple TV stats overlay line: this device's access level. Followed by ' · ' and grant_chip_ends while access is timed.
apple_overlay_access_controller: Apple TV stats overlay line: this device's access level.
apple_overlay_access_view: Apple TV stats overlay line: this device's access level.
apple_overlay_access_custom: Apple TV stats overlay line: this device's access level.
apple_capture_keys: Stats overlay hint on iPhone, iPad and Vision Pro until input is captured. keys = the shortcut, e.g. '⌘⎋'.
apple_hud_disconnect_keys: Mac stats overlay button. keys = its shortcut, e.g. '⌃⌥⇧D'.
apple_hud_mute_mic_keys: Mac stats overlay button. keys = its shortcut, e.g. '⌃⌥⇧A'.
apple_hud_unmute_mic_keys: Mac stats overlay button. keys = its shortcut, e.g. '⌃⌥⇧A'.
apple_mute_microphone: Stats overlay button on iPhone and iPad, and the touch disc's screen-reader label.
apple_unmute_microphone: Stats overlay button on iPhone and iPad, and the touch disc's screen-reader label.
apple_sc2_refused: Mac badge over the stream when the system refused the Steam Controller passthrough. The path names macOS settings; use the system's own German names.
apple_vrr_warning: Mac banner over the stream with two buttons. The path names macOS settings; use the system's own German names.
apple_vrr_dont_warn: Button on the Mac variable-refresh banner: hides it for good.
apple_motion_unreachable_a11y: Screen-reader text of the motion badge. 'Controller type' is the setting's label.
apple_sc2_passing_through: Badge over the stream when a Steam Controller is captured and sent to the host as itself.
apple_sc2_passing_through_a11y: Screen-reader text of the Steam Controller badge.
apple_access_level_a11y: Screen-reader label of the access chip; the level and remaining time follow as its value.
apple_touch_unsupported_a11y: Screen-reader text of the touch-fallback badge.
apple_quick_actions_a11y: Screen-reader label of the touch disc that opens quick actions.
apple_new_window: Button in the stream window's ornament: opens another main window.
apple_curve_streaming: Vision Pro: the stream window while the picture is on the curved screen.
apple_curve_end_stream: Vision Pro: button in the stream window while the picture is on the curved screen.
apple_widget_library_intent_title: Game library widget's configuration intent title (shown when editing the widget). Must equal the Swift literal.
apple_widget_library_intent_desc: Game library widget's configuration intent description.
apple_widget_library_param_host_desc: Game library widget: the Host parameter's description.
apple_widget_library_name: Game library widget's name in the widget gallery and on the widget.
apple_widget_library_desc: Game library widget's description in the widget gallery.
apple_widget_library_label: Game library widget on the Lock Screen, under the host's name.
apple_widget_library_empty: Game library widget when no host is saved.
apple_widget_hosts_name: Hosts widget's name in the widget gallery.
apple_widget_hosts_desc: Hosts widget's description in the widget gallery.
apple_widget_hosts_empty: Hosts widget when no host is saved.
apple_live_streaming: Live Activity status while the stream runs.
apple_live_background_ends_in: Live Activity status while backgrounded; a live countdown clock follows it.
apple_live_background: Live Activity status while backgrounded with no deadline.
apple_live_reconnecting: Live Activity status while the stream redials.
apple_live_ended: Live Activity status after the stream ended.
apple_live_end_session: Live Activity's large button in the expanded Dynamic Island.
apple_live_end: Live Activity's small button on the Lock Screen banner.
apple_intent_end_stream_title: App Intent title in Shortcuts and Siri. Must equal the Swift literal.
apple_intent_connect_title: App Intent title in Shortcuts and Siri. Must equal the Swift literal.
apple_intent_param_host: App Intent parameter title (connect, library, wake, widget). Must equal the Swift literal.
apple_intent_param_game_id: App Intent parameter title. Must equal the Swift literal.
apple_intent_param_game_id_desc: App Intent parameter description. 'steam:570' is an example id: keep it.
apple_intent_param_preset: App Intent parameter title: a settings preset. Must equal the Swift literal.
apple_intent_open_library_title: App Intent title in Shortcuts and Siri. Must equal the Swift literal.
apple_intent_wake_title: App Intent title in Shortcuts and Siri. Must equal the Swift literal.
apple_intent_error_no_wake: Failure text of the Wake host intent in Shortcuts and Siri.
apple_entity_host: App Entity type name in Shortcuts: a saved host.
apple_entity_preset: App Entity type name in Shortcuts: a settings preset.
apple_shortcut_connect_phrase: Siri / Spotlight phrase. host = a saved host's name; applicationName = the app's name. Must equal the Swift literal with ${host} / ${application_name}.
apple_shortcut_stream_phrase: Siri / Spotlight phrase. host = a saved host's name; applicationName = the app's name.
apple_shortcut_library_phrase: Siri / Spotlight phrase. host = a saved host's name; applicationName = the app's name.
apple_shortcut_games_phrase: Siri / Spotlight phrase. host = a saved host's name; applicationName = the app's name.
apple_shortcut_wake_phrase: Siri / Spotlight phrase. host = a saved host's name; applicationName = the app's name.
apple_shortcut_end_phrase: Siri / Spotlight phrase. applicationName = the app's name.
apple_shortcut_connect_short: App Shortcut short title in Spotlight and the Shortcuts app.
apple_shortcut_library_short: App Shortcut short title in Spotlight and the Shortcuts app.
apple_shortcut_wake_short: App Shortcut short title in Spotlight and the Shortcuts app.
apple_shortcut_end_short: App Shortcut short title in Spotlight and the Shortcuts app.
apple_usage_local_network: System permission prompt for local network access (NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription).
apple_usage_microphone: System permission prompt for the microphone (NSMicrophoneUsageDescription).
apple_usage_face_id: System permission prompt for Face ID (NSFaceIDUsageDescription).
apple_usage_bluetooth: System permission prompt for Bluetooth (NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription and NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription).
apple_pad_rumble_failed: Console notice on Apple after the Controllers tab's rumble test failed. error = the system's own error description.
